caption: Scrovegni Chapel, Padua
composition: Tall brick Gothic chapel beside Arena gardens ruins · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands in the garden beside the Scrovegni Chapel at midday, the plain brick Gothic block filling the right half of the frame. Its tall lancet windows and simple gabled roof rise above the lawn, while the ruined stones of the old Roman arena peek through the trees at the left. The modelled 23 September 2026, 12:50 sun is bright overhead, the terracotta brick glowing warm against a clear blue sky scattered with small white clouds.
